content: 1. Administer 1 to 2 sachets orally once or twice daily. Place the granules directly on the tongue and swallow with 250 mL of water. 2. For individuals older than 12 years, the dosage is the same as the adult dose. 3. For individuals younger than 12 years, the safety and efficacy of this medication have not been established. 4. Both sterculia and deflazacort can lead to a reduction in serum potassium levels. Exercise caution and monitor potassium levels closely. 5. Sterculia reduces the effects of sodium picosulfate through an unspecified interaction mechanism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown, but close monitoring is advised. 6. Potential adverse effects include constipation, flatulence, abdominal cramping, fecal impaction, hypersensitivity reactions, gastrointestinal obstruction, symptoms resembling appendicitis or an acute surgical abdomen, gastrointestinal ulceration, dysphagia, and rectal bleeding. 7. Ensure adequate water intake when using this preparation to minimize the risk of adverse effects. 8. This medication is not recommended for use in individuals experiencing abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, or fever. 9. Separate the administration of this medication from all other medications by at least 2 hours, as laxatives may interfere with the absorption of other drugs. 10. Pregnancy Category: Not applicable. 11. Lactation: There is no available data, but as the medication is not absorbed systemically, it is unlikely to pose a risk to breastfeeding infants. 12. In general, this medication is considered acceptable during pregnancy. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk.
